items.title: 33.5 Effect of Water Pollution on the Environment (pani ki pollution ka mahol par asar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 33.5 (PDF 255-256); the biomagnification drawing is our own. Quick Check answers were written for the lesson and need review.

blocks.text: Pollutants pani ki physical aur chemical properties badal dete hain, jis se paudon aur janwaron ka zinda rehna mushkil ho jata hai. Environment (mahol) par aam asraat yeh hain: loss of biodiversity (jaandaron ki qismon ka nuqsan), habitat destruction (rehne ki jagahon ki tabahi), food chains ka bigarna aur pani ki quality ka girna.
1. Destruction of Eco Systems and Biodiversity (ecosystems aur biodiversity ki tabahi)

Tel, heavy metals aur pesticides jaisi pollution, aur daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron mein jane wale nuqsan-deh chemicals, plastic aur kachra, ecosystems aur aquatic life (pani ki zindagi) ko sakht nuqsan dete hain. Polluted pani mein oxygen kam ho jati hai (hypoxia), aur pani ke jaandaron ka zinda rehna mushkil ho jata hai. Coral reefs kharab hote hain aur food chains bigar jati hain. Zehreele chemicals, sewage aur industrial waste aquatic organisms (pani ke jaandaron) ko maar ya nuqsan pohancha sakte hain, is liye pani mein zindagi ki qismein kam ho jati hain. Polluted pani breeding cycles (bachay paida karne ke chakkar), food sources (khuraak ke zariye) aur migration patterns (hijrat ke raaste) bigar deta hai; is se population (tadaad) ghatti hai aur sensitive (nazuk) species bilkul extinct (khatam) bhi ho sakti hain. Pani par depend karne wale parinde aur janwar bhi affect hote hain.

Fertilizers aur sewage se aane wali excess (faltu) nitrogen aur phosphorus se nutrient overload hota hai aur algae tezi se barhti hai. Algae dhoop rok leti hai aur pani mein oxygen kam kar deti hai. Eutrophication ecosystems bigarti, machhliyan aur doosri marine species (samandari jaandaar) maarti aur pani ki quality kharab karti hai.

Bioaccumulation aur biomagnification pani ki pollution ke serious adverse effects (sangeen bure asraat) hain: mercury, lead aur pesticides jaise toxic substances (zehreele maadde) waqt ke saath jandaron ke jism mein jama hote jate hain (bioaccumulation). Food chain mein har qadam oopar jate hue in zehron ki concentration barhti jati hai (biomagnification). Is liye sab se oopar ke shikari (top predators), insan samet, aksar sab se zyada miqdar (dose) lete hain.

blocks.alt: Barhti oonchai ke paanch dabbe teeron se jure: pani, plankton, chhoti machhli, bari machhli, aur insan samet oopar ke shikari. Mercury, lead ya pesticide jaise zehr ke surkh nuqte baen se daen har dabbe mein barhte jate hain.
blocks.caption: Bioaccumulation aur biomagnification (hamari drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).
blocks.long_description: Har janwar apne neeche ke bohat se jandaar khata aur zehr ko nikalne ke bajaye jama karta hai, is liye food chain ke har qadam par concentration barhta hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen se daen food chain mein oopar jaate hain: pani → plankton → chhoti machhli → bari machhli → top predators (insan samet). Har dabbe mein surkh nuqte (zehr) zyada hote jaate hain, kyunke har jaandaar apni khuraak ka zehr apne jism mein jama karta hai aur woh bahar nahi nikalta. Is liye sab se oopar wale ko sab se zyada dose milti hai.
4. Soil Degradation and Plant Life Damage (mitti ki kharabi aur paudon ko nuqsan)

Pani ki pollution mitti ko kharab (soil degradation) karti aur paudon ko nuqsan deti hai. Heavy metals, industrial waste aur excessive nutrients mitti mein seep ho kar (ris kar) us ka structure (banawat) aur fertility (zarkhezi) badal dete hain. Jama hue chemicals mitti ki natural microbial activity (microbes ka kaam) bigarte hain, jo paudon ki sehat ke liye zaroori hai. Polluted pani lagne se paude chhote reh jate hain (stunted growth), leaf discoloration (patton ka rang badalna) hota hai, aur paude mar bhi sakte hain.
5. Methane Emission by Decaying Organic Matter (galte organic matter se methane ka nikalna)

Jab sewage, kheton ka behta pani ya industry ka waste pani mein jata hai to algae aur doosre jandaar tezi se barhte hain. Jab yeh mar kar kam oxygen wale (anaerobic) halaat mein galte hain to methane nikalti hai, jo ek taqatwar greenhouse gas hai. Yeh faltu methane climate change (mausami tabdeeli) aur global warming ko barhati hai.

blocks.prompt: a) (i) Methylmercury ([CH₃Hg]⁺) “charbi mein bohat ghulti” hai. Is ke chemical structure ka inorganic Hg²⁺ ion se contrast (farq) batayein, aur batayein ke methyl group (-CH₃) cell ki lipid bilayer mein is ki solubility kyun badal deta hai.
blocks.explanation: Hg²⁺ chhota ion hai jis par 2+ charge hai; pani ke molecules ise mazbooti se gher lete hain, is liye yeh pani mein rehta hai aur non-polar lipid bilayer paar nahi kar pata. [CH₃Hg]⁺ mein mercury se non-polar methyl group jura hai aur charge sirf 1+ hai, is liye yeh kam polar hai, lipid bilayer mein ghul jata hai aur cell membranes aur blood-brain barrier paar kar leta hai.

rows: Sirf aik mercury ion, koi organic group nahi
Mercury se non-polar –CH₃ group jura hai
Pani ke molecules mazbooti se gher lete hain (zyada polar)
Kam polar, fat (charbi) mein zyada ghulta hai
Lipid bilayer mushkil se paar karta hai
Lipid bilayer aur blood-brain barrier aasani se paar karta hai

blocks.prompt: a) (ii) Agar [CH₃Hg]⁺ pani mein bohat ghulta aur charbi mein kam ghulta to biomagnification par kya asar hota?
blocks.explanation: Biomagnification bohat kam hoti: pani mein ghulne wala substance urine (peshab) waghera se jaldi jism se nikal jata hai aur charbi ke tissues mein jama nahi hota, is liye food chain ke har qadam par nahi barhta.

blocks.prompt: b) Pani ki pollution global warming mein kaise hissa dalti hai?
blocks.explanation: Sewage aur nutrients wala pani algae aur doosre jandaron ko barhata hai; jab yeh kam oxygen (anaerobic) halaat mein mar kar galte hain to methane nikalti hai, jo taqatwar greenhouse gas hai.

items: Asraat: ecosystems aur biodiversity ki tabahi, eutrophication, bioaccumulation aur biomagnification, mitti aur paudon ka nuqsan, methane.
Top predators, insan samet, sab se zyada zehr lete hain.
